propositions: add_dependency silently escalates cross-subtree blocking links to ancestor children and prints the redirect record only to stdout, which library and MCP callers cannot see
rebar.link() calls composer.link_core(..., quiet=True) which redirects stdout to a sink, so the escalation record is discarded and the caller receives only 'ok'
link_tickets MCP tool returns literal 'ok' regardless of whether the requested edge was substituted, giving agents no indication of escalation

the redirect record must be returned as a value through five propagation layers (add_dependency -> link_core -> _link closure -> _python_leaf -> rebar.link()) where three currently drop it without returning

stdout suppression via quiet=True is required to protect the MCP stdio stream and other in-process callers (reconciler, code review, voter) from stray output corruption, so the fix must make the record a return value while leaving quiet unchanged
